name: auvik-pp-mcp
description: Every Auvik endpoint as a command, plus the cross-client answers the Auvik UI and API cannot give you.

auvik_username.title: Auvik user email
auvik_username.description: The email address of the Auvik user whose API key you are using. Auvik authenticates with HTTP Basic; this is the username half.

auvik_api_key.title: Auvik API key
auvik_api_key.description: Auvik > Admin > Integrations > Auvik API. This is the password half of the Basic credential.

auvik_base_url.title: Auvik regional API host
auvik_base_url.description: Your Auvik region's host, with no path suffix - for example https://auvikapi.us1.my.auvik.com. The wrong region returns a 401 that looks like a bad key.

auvik_tenant.title: Default Auvik tenant ID
auvik_tenant.description: Tenant ID the inventory reads and sync default to (the --tenant flag overrides it). Child tenants are included in the response. Leave blank to use your credential's own tenant.

auvik_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
auvik_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Auvik requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
